add_typelib(activeds_tlb.idl)
add_idl_reg_objects(activeds.tlb regtypelib activeds_tlb.idl)

# activeds.tlb is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/activeds_tlb-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
set(ACTIVEDS_TLB_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/win32/activeds.tlb/activeds_tlb_t.o)
add_cargo_module(activeds.tlb activeds_tlb-cargo activeds.tlb
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS activeds.tlb_t ${ACTIVEDS_TLB_REUSED})
